title: denÄnglens' Recipes
description: A few recipes that make some items more accessible.
body:
Adds crafting recipes for items to make them more accessible.

I want to preface by saying that this mod is not very balanced for regular minecraft, and is kinda made for use with my other datapack, [denAnglens' Mortalis](https://modrinth.com/project/denanglens-mortalis) which regularly resets player progress.


# Recipes

The heavy core:
- 2 shulker shells
- Heart of the sea
- 2 diamonds
  
![Heavy core crafting recipe](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/fdb200cdd1f9b6f3f087ceda44a5ef593c1526a6.png)

Shulker shells:
- Amethys shard
- Echo shard
- Diamond

![Shulker shell crafting recipe](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/63c4d3c46a0ba26ffe4e6c04c091f4a19a717746.png)

Sponge:
- 4 of any wool
- 2 honey blocks
- 2 slimeballs
- 1 bucket

![Sponge crafting recipe](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/0595d8b8b44df4a3dbebafba03008e95235d055f.png)

Totem of undying:
- 4 gold ingots
- 2 emeralds or diamonds
- Heart of the sea

![Totem crafting recipe](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/1684efea35ec5363779c887c9edb99b7918af602.png)

Trident:
- Iron spear
- 2 amethys shards
- Heart of the sea
- 2 diamonds
- Stick

![Trident crafting recipe](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/db8a30d5e0f52c65e858d361dc160cf3ea9da98a.png)
